description: Source code for the 'FullandFinalStatement' document in an ERP system, handling employee final settlement processes including validation, asset management, and journal entry creation.

classes.name: FullandFinalStatement
classes.description: Represents an employee's full and final settlement process, including validation, asset management, and journal entry creation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before submission, including outstanding statements, settlement, and asset return validation.

methods.name: validate_settlement
methods.description: Checks if all payables and receivables are settled before submission.

methods.name: validate_asset
methods.description: Ensures all allocated assets are returned before submission.

methods.name: get_outstanding_statements
methods.description: Generates outstanding payables, receivables, and asset movements if reliving date is set.

methods.name: create_component_row
methods.description: Creates rows for payables or receivables components.

methods.name: get_assets_movement
methods.description: Retrieves asset movement data related to the employee.

methods.name: create_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for the settlement, including payables and receivables.
